title: Velvet Curfew
description: A nocturnal, bass-led 2-step roller that builds from a shuffled hat groove into a chopped soul-vocal hook riding a rolling sub. Sidechained pads pump under broken kicks while the filter slowly opens across the arc, breaking down to pure pad-and-vocal space before a euphoric final lift.
code:
setcpm(132/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.9),
    s("hh(5,8,2)").bank("RolandTR707").cut(1).gain(0.55).hpf(6000),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(280).gain(0.8)
  ).swingBy(0.16, 8)],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.95),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.7).room(0.2),
    s("hh(7,8,2)").bank("RolandTR707").cut(1).gain(0.55),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(sine.slow(16).range(300,900)).gain(0.85).shape(0.2),
    s("swpad").n("<0 1>").note("<c3 eb3 ab2 g2>").slow(2).gain(saw.slow(2).range(0.3,0.85)).lpf(1200).room(0.3)
  ).swingBy(0.16, 8)],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.95),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.72).room(0.25),
    s("rim*2").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.4).pan(0.7),
    s("hh(7,8,2)").bank("RolandTR707").cut(1).gain(0.55).every(4, x => x.ply(2)),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(sine.slow(16).range(500,1400)).gain(0.85).shape(0.25),
    s("numbers").chop(8).slice(8, "0 2 4 6 1 3 5 7").speed("<1 1.5 0.5>").gain(0.75).vowel("<a e o>").room(0.25).delay(0.3),
    s("swpad").n("<0 1 2>").note("<c3 eb3 ab2 g2>").slow(2).gain(saw.slow(2).range(0.3,0.85)).lpf(2000).room(0.3)
  ).swingBy(0.16, 8)],
  [16, stack(
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(700).gain(0.7),
    s("numbers").chop(8).slice(8, "0 ~ 4 ~ 2 ~ 6 ~").speed("<0.5 1>").gain(0.7).vowel("<a o>").room(0.5).delay(".5:.125:.6"),
    s("swpad").n(2).note("<c3 eb3 ab2 g2>").slow(2).gain(0.7).lpf(2200).room(0.6).delay(0.4)
  ).swingBy(0.16, 8)],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR707").gain(1.0),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.75).room(0.25),
    s("rim(3,8)").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.45).pan(0.7),
    s("hh(7,8,2)").bank("RolandTR707").cut(1).gain(0.55).every(4, x => x.ply("<2 4>")),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(sine.slow(8).range(700,2200)).gain(0.9).shape(0.3),
    n("0 ~ 3 ~").scale("C4:minor").s("square").decay(0.12).sustain(0).gain(0.5).room(0.2).off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.35)),
    s("numbers").chop(8).slice(8, "0 2 4 6 1 3 5 7").speed("<1 1.5 0.5 2>").gain(0.78).vowel("<a e o>").crush(8).room(0.25).delay(0.3).sometimesBy(0.25, x => x.speed(2)),
    s("swpad").n("<2 3>").note("<c3 eb3 ab2 g2>").slow(2).gain(saw.slow(2).range(0.35,0.9)).lpf(2600).room(0.35)
  ).swingBy(0.16, 8)],
  [12, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.8),
    s("hh(5,8,2)").bank("RolandTR707").cut(1).gain(0.5).hpf(6000),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(500).gain(0.7),
    s("swpad").n(0).note("<c3 eb3 ab2 g2>").slow(2).gain(0.6).lpf(1400).room(0.6).delay(0.4)
  ).swingBy(0.16, 8)]
)
